title: The Golden Rule of Data Transformation
description: Why transformations belong as close to the source as possible — and what happens when they don't. A practical guide to building cleaner, more maintainable data pipelines.
codeSnippet:
-- Bad: transform in the report layer
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN revenue END)

-- Good: transform upstream in the semantic layer
MEASURE ActiveRevenue = CALCULATE([Revenue], Status[status] = "active")

title: CI/CD for Power BI Semantic Models
description: Setting up automated deployment pipelines for Power BI semantic models using Azure DevOps and Tabular Editor. Version control your TMDL, validate on PR, deploy on merge.
codeSnippet:
# azure-pipelines.yml
- task: PowerShell@2
  displayName: 'Deploy Semantic Model'
  inputs:
    script: |
      TabularEditor.exe model.bim -D `
        "${{ variables.PBI_WORKSPACE }}" `
        "${{ variables.DATASET_NAME }}" -V
